data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate recorded gross adverse prior-year reserve development of $26.8m (3.98% of opening gross claims outstanding), driven predominantly by adverse reserve development in earlier underwriting years (notably the 2018 year) within the Non-Marine Liability (Casualty) portfolio where a number of large individual losses and social inflation pressures increased claims estimates. The reported net deterioration statement ($7.832m net) exists in the notes but the gross prior-year strengthening has been calculated from the published gross claims development table. Current-year catastrophe activity (Ida, Texas Winter Storm, Storm Volker, Bernd flooding) materially impacted the 2021 result but is separate from the prior-year reserve strengthening.
raw_causal_phrases: Included within net calendar year claims incurred of $196,366,000 (2020: $172,472,000) is a deterioration of $7,832,000 in claims reserves established at the prior year end (2020: release $6,620,000).
The 2018 year has experienced further adverse loss experience in the Construction and Binders sub-classes from a number of individual large losses.
The class has been further affected by social inflation, whereby we have seen an increase in the frequency of claims and a higher percentage of insureds making claims.
The total net cost to Syndicate 1969 of these events for the 2021 calendar year exceeded the catastrophe allowance for the calendar year by $25.3m.

data.data_quality_notes: Amounts presented in this JSON are in the report's native currency (USD) and expressed in millions. Opening gross claims outstanding taken from the balance sheet prior-year comparative (31-Dec-2020 claims outstanding = $673,033k). A gross prior-year development amount was not provided explicitly in a single 'movement in prior year's provision' gross line, so the gross PYD (+$26.8m) was calculated from the published gross claims development triangle (comparing current estimates to the prior diagonal and excluding the two most recent underwriting years 2021 and 2020). The note sentence quoting a $7.832m deterioration is a net figure (after reinsurance) - quoted verbatim above. The syndicate transferred 2017 and prior reserves out via a reinsurance to close to Syndicate 1994 which removes older years from the triangle; the triangle used covers 2018 onwards. Users should note the mix of net and gross figures in the narrative; where possible gross sources were preferred.
